page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated execution resources without hyper-threading. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring the attachment of external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps, which facilitates high-throughput data transfers. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio offer predictable performance for enterprise workloads, avoiding the resource contention typical of shared or hyper-threaded environments.

The ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is designed for general-purpose enterprise workloads. The balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it suitable for application servers, medium-sized databases, containerized microservices, and continuous integration pipelines that require consistent CPU performance and moderate memory capacity without the need for hardware acceleration or local NVMe storage.
